title: Minigame: A21.13 Non-Qualified Use

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the A21.13 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): the fewest counters A21.11, A21.12, and A21.13 need, on an imported board.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): the units are set up by hand, a German Gun manned by its crew and a second by a squad, a captured Russian Gun manned by a German crew and by a German HS, two German leaders on a Gun, a lone leader, and a hero, in the PFPh and the DFPh.

introduction: Crews, squads, leaders, and a hero fire their own side's Guns and a captured one, with and without the A21.11 and A21.12 penalties.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
